title: AcquisitionStatus
description: The complete, granular acquisition lifecycle for a ResearchSourceCandidate (PROGRAM-004 Owner Decision 2, 2026-07-25). No state is collapsed. DISCOVERED is the transient, pre-validation moment a possible source was identified -- it is never itself persisted to a candidate file; REGISTERED is the first state that is ever written to disk, meaning a durable candidate record was successfully created and passed structural validation. APPROVED_FOR_ACQUISITION, APPROVED_FOR_RESEARCH_INTAKE, and REJECTED may only be reached via an active OwnerDecision -- never automatically. This is a shared, versioned enum definition, referenced by research-source-candidate.schema.json.
$comment: Allowed transitions (enforced by scripts/trader_intelligence/acquisition_common.py:ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, not by this schema alone): DISCOVERED->REGISTERED (in-memory only, requires successful validation); REGISTERED->METADATA_PENDING|METADATA_VERIFIED; METADATA_PENDING->METADATA_VERIFIED; METADATA_VERIFIED->DUPLICATE_REVIEW; DUPLICATE_REVIEW->PRIORITIZED; PRIORITIZED->OWNER_REVIEW; OWNER_REVIEW->APPROVED_FOR_ACQUISITION|REJECTED (OwnerDecision required); APPROVED_FOR_ACQUISITION->ACQUISITION_IN_PROGRESS; ACQUISITION_IN_PROGRESS->ACQUIRED|ACQUISITION_FAILED; ACQUISITION_FAILED->APPROVED_FOR_ACQUISITION (retry, requires a fresh OwnerDecision); ACQUIRED->APPROVED_FOR_EXTRACTION; APPROVED_FOR_EXTRACTION->EXTRACTION_IN_PROGRESS; EXTRACTION_IN_PROGRESS->EXTRACTED; EXTRACTED->READY_FOR_RESEARCH_INTAKE; READY_FOR_RESEARCH_INTAKE->APPROVED_FOR_RESEARCH_INTAKE (OwnerDecision required, never automatic); any non-terminal state->REJECTED (OwnerDecision required) or ->ARCHIVED (owner action, no OwnerDecision strictly required since it discards nothing and grants no authority).
